The '''Geharran royal family''' was the family to which the [[Deaon/Legends|Deaon]] [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchs]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] belonged. They claimed descent from [[Grand Vicar]] [[Sidharra]] of the [[Pius Dea]] cult.<ref name="Strongholds" />
